text:
alex: Prelaunch rollcall — canary warmup in 30m. We're pinning the model to v3.2.1 for the canary. Need rollback owners + smoke-check owners. @ops-oncall will watch infra, @sasha you own canary validation. Drop your quick confirmations and any last-minute blockers.

sasha: Got it. I will run the short prompt suite and hallucination checks. Do we allow embeddings traffic on the canary or keep it synthetic?

maya: Confirming we leave embeddings on for baseline metrics, but throttle to 10r/s. Release notes updated with the quant flag change — see the PR link in Confluence.

jen: I'll take rollback owner for the API route. Rollback plan: pin back to v3.2.0 and drain canary pool. I can execute within ~15m if needed.

ops-oncall: Monitoring hooks configured: queue length, GPU mem, and pod restarts. I set alerting at GPU mem > 85% and queue latency > 250ms.

deploy-bot: Automated: Canary scheduled for 3345006970. Config: route 2% traffic -> canary-gpu-pool. Model pinned: v3.2.1. Auto-cut policy: if error rate > 3% for 5m, reduce canary to 0% and notify #eng-oncall.

sasha: Adding a quick validation note — run prompt-sensitivity check against 15 seed prompts to detect hallucination drift. I'll post results.

alex: Smoke commands for the run: ```./smoke.sh --suite short --target canary```
Health check: ```curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq .```
Also grab per-route p95 latency and 5xx counts before/after.

maya: :thumbsup: grabbing cost baseline now (per-token) and saving to the release dashboard.

jen: Quick rollback checklist (if we need it):
1) pin runtime to v3.2.0 via deployctl pin model v3.2.0
2) disable canary routing: deployctl set-traffic canary 0
3) trigger canary-cleanup job: k8s job canary-cleanup/run
4) post rollback note to #eng-releases and open incident if infra impacted
I can run steps 1-3 if asked.

sasha: Will post validation summary to this thread once smoke completes. If we see any hallucination uptick > 2x baseline, we stop.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 3345006970. PID=4821. Routing: 2% -> canary-gpu-pool. Monitoring hooks: latency p95, 5xx rate, embed-mismatch.%

alex: Reminder: if manual freeze is needed, call it loudly. Quick freeze procedure: pin, disable autoscale, revert traffic. Full protocol in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/release-freeze (internal).

ops-oncall: Alarms set and I have escalation to infra-sre if GPU utilization crosses 90% or persistent OOMs.

jen: Ready and on standby. Ping @jen if we need immediate rollback actions.

alex: Thanks team — closing rollcall. I'll follow up with post-canary notes and any required pin logs.
